verdict_basis: qwen_reasoning_accuracy_pct (62.50%) beats both the majority-class baseline (56.25%) and the rule-based threshold (50.00%) on this 16-case set. NOT treating this as a clean GO for three honest reasons: (1) n=16 is too small -- one flipped case moves the result 6.25pp; (2) the threshold baseline here is not representative of real coherence_gate.rs traffic -- in production, content reaching the gate already passed a nearest-neighbor/vector search, so its cosine similarity starts much higher than these hand-authored synthetic pairs (15/16 pairs scored below 0.85, an artificially harsh scenario for the threshold, not the real distribution); (3) Qwen3.5-2B produced one factual hallucination (case borderline_paraphrase_low_lexical_1: claimed the content described 'a Linux kernel installation process' when the actual content was a Windows-specific paraphrase) -- concerning for a security-relevant gate, independent of the accuracy number.
genuine_positive_signal: Qwen correctly caught two cases a cosine threshold structurally cannot: (1) borderline_injection_style_not_pattern_1 -- authorization-impersonation framing with zero literal pattern match, rejected correctly with explicit safety reasoning; (2) borderline_opposite_claim_1 -- a high-lexical-overlap FALSE claim about today's real NO-GO result, rejected correctly by catching the factual contradiction, something a cosine score can never detect.
next_step_before_production: Re-run against REAL recall-retrieved candidates (post similarity search, from an actual tylluan_recall call) instead of synthetic hand-authored pairs, and expand to at least 50 real cases, before considering any integration with coherence_gate.rs.
